name: VoxTicket E3 live three-arm scenarios
notes: Same scenarios, same order, for every arm (ALWAYS_TIER_1, ALWAYS_TIER_2, HYBRID). Run the e3_live.py runner once per arm against a backend started with that strategy (VOXTICKET_AI_SELECTOR_STRATEGY, default HYBRID). The runner records the DECLARED arm: the chat response carries no tier field, so the arm cannot be verified from the response alone — confirm it from backend log lines 'event=routing_decision ... strategy=...' for the run window, or run e3_log_parse.py over a saved backend log. Do not complete procedures: cancellation/return messages are first turns only; never confirm a procedure inside an E3 run, so the demo orders stay untouched. Warm up first (a few unrecorded turns) and space calls per the RPM setting.

scenarios.message: What is the status of my order?
How long do refunds take to appear in my account?
Can I return an item I bought?
What payment methods do you accept?
میں اپنا آرڈر کیسے واپس کر سکتا ہوں؟
I want to return one item from my order and also ask how long the refund will take for another item.
Should I file a claim or a return for an item that arrived damaged?
If my order has already shipped, can I still cancel it, and what happens to my payment?
I have two orders, one delivered and one still processing. What can I do with each of them?
It is not what I expected.
Can I talk to a human agent about my problem?
Mera parcel damage aya hai, mujhe refund chahiye ya replacement milegi?
میرا پارسل گم ہو گیا ہے، مجھے کیا کرنا چاہیے؟
